content:
anna_vendor: quick update from the forwarder for RDW-7621 — one container is held in FRA customs, they flagged HS-code mismatch, ETA slipped from 2026-04-28 to 2026-05-03. AWB 123-4567890.

maria_procurement: ugh, thanks for flagging. which SKUs impacted? H100 or H200?

anna_vendor: mostly H200s (~24 units) + 6 H100s mixed in the same pallet. forwarder says they can reclassify but it adds ~72h processing and a brokerage fee.

devon_ops: that gap will hurt our EU cluster rollout this week. current spare pool is zero for GCP-us-west failover. can we get loaners? @kevin_logistics any loaner availability?

kevin_logistics: we have 8 loaner units sitting in AMS staging (serial-escrow). I can air-move 6 to FRA and two to CDG same-day if we pay expedite surcharge (~€1.2k per AWB).

maria_procurement: cost vs time tradeoff. what's the SLA hit if we don't move loaners? Julia, do we have a quant?

julia_sre: if EU can't get H200 capacity online by Mon, latency p50 for inference-heavy routes climbs ~25-30% and some batch jobs will queue. Not catastrophic but several paid customers will see degraded throughput.

sam_ops: can we triage which customers get the temporary loaners? prioritize enterprise customers on Dedicated.

maria_procurement: yes prioritize: Acme, NovaHealth, and Greenline. we'll absorb expedite cost under contingency budget if vendor can't clear customs fast.

anna_vendor: on the RMA side — a depot inspection flagged 3 serial mismatches vs manifest (labels swapped on two H200 units). vendor can open RMA consolidation to avoid multiple AWBs. Suggestion: create single consolidated RMA and route returns back with original shipment to reduce customs friction.

devon_ops: that sounds sensible. What's the RMA ID?

rma_bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-9054 for RDW-7621 (3 units). Link: https://rma.internal/RMA-9054

kevin_logistics: consolidation saves ~€850 in brokerage + paperwork. downside: longer turn-in time if depot needs photos and serial re-tags.

maria_procurement: we need photo evidence and depot sign-off to proceed. @anna_vendor can you upload the manifest photos and the re-tag proof?

anna_vendor: uploaded 3 photos and the depot acceptance note to the RMA ticket. Also included the manifest diff.

anna_vendor: manifest diff snippet:
```
Expected:
- H200 S/N: H200-AX-00123
- H200 S/N: H200-AX-00124
- H200 S/N: H200-AX-00125
Found:
- H200 S/N: H200-AX-00125
- H200 S/N: H200-AX-00123
- H200 S/N: H200-AX-00126
```

sam_ops: last one looks like a wrong unit entirely (00126). Can depot verify if 00126 belongs to another order or temp pool?

anna_vendor: depot says 00126 is in temp escrow from RDW-7598. We'll request swap-back and include serial cross-check.

maria_procurement: timeline decision: two options — (A) consolidate RMA, accept 72h customs reclass + swap-back (lower shipping cost but slower), or (B) expedite loaners to keep SLAs and let RMA process separately (higher cost). Recommend A for long-term cost but B if we value immediate SLOs.

devon_ops: choose B for EU production this week. Set up priority loaner move for Acme/NovaHealth/Greenline. After that, proceed with consolidated RMA and reclassify with customs to unblock the container.

kevin_logistics: I'll book air-move for 6 units AMS->FRA, AWB TBD. Need PO sign-off from procurement.

maria_procurement: approved. Charge to contingency budget code CONT-OPS-2026. Please include invoice estimate.

kevin_logistics: noted. ETA for loaners to FRA: 12 hours after booking.

julia_sre: once loaners move, I'll reroute traffic and pin critical customers to Dedicated EU capacity so churn is minimized. Keep me posted on AWB and RMA-9054 status.

rma_bot: RMA-9054 updated: photos attached, depot_verified=true, consolidation_flag=true. Next step: arrange return AWB consolidation.

anna_vendor: I'll coordinate AWB consolidation and confirm HS-code reclassification request with customs broker. Will post when broker confirms.

maria_procurement: thanks all. Quick ask — save the loaner serials to the incident runbook so we can track utilization and billing back to customers if needed.

sam_ops: logged in incident runbook: loaner-allocs/4801234567 (Acme,NovaHealth,Greenline).

devon_ops: cheers. keep updates short here, call me if any regulator paperwork blocks reclassification. :thumbsup:
